description: This file manages font glyph subsetting using web workers or main thread fallback, including lazy loading of worker chunks and worker pool management.

methods.name: subsetWoff2GlyphsByCodepoints
methods.description: Asynchronously subsets font glyphs in WOFF2 format based on codepoints, utilizing web workers if available, otherwise falls back to main thread.

methods.name: lazyLoadWorkerSubsetChunk
methods.description: Dynamically imports the worker chunk for subsetting operations, with caching.

methods.name: lazyLoadSharedSubsetChunk
methods.description: Dynamically imports the shared chunk used for subsetting, with caching.

methods.name: getOrCreateWorkerPool
methods.description: Initializes or retrieves the singleton worker pool for font subsetting, handling errors implicitly.
